description: 6 exemplars (one German) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-13 under road-to-skill-scripts-that-run-where-they-land, which rewrote this skill's grounded Tailwind-layer invocation to the bundled `node <skills-root>/…/ground.mjs` form and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars are the primitive-library surface its own When-to-use names — forms, modals, dropdowns, toasts, slots and variants — on a project that actually depends on livewire/flux, which is the condition that selects this skill over its two siblings. Near-misses are the three boundaries the skill draws for itself: component state and actions (livewire), a raw Blade partial with no Flux in the project (blade-ui), and the same dialog on the React stack (react-shadcn-ui). Counterexamples guard the word flux where it is not this package at all — the Flux architecture pattern in a Redux codebase, and magnetic flux in a datasheet.
